how_it_picks: With ?skin=<id> in the URL the page previews that skin. Otherwise it takes the skin whose window contains the current Pasadena date and time; when windows overlap, the shortest window wins, then the earlier entry in this list. With no window open it is La maison.
how_owners_switch: One theme setting (Theme settings > Skin: Auto, or a named skin). Auto follows this calendar and reverts by itself when a window closes.
what_a_skin_may_change: Colour, motif and decoration (CSS variables: accent, canvas, hairline, display weight, motif; Halloween also the cobweb rule, ghost macarons and scalloped cards, plus at most one decorative pseudo-element rule), and one dated greeting line in the marked slot (greeting.text plus the window dates). Never the product set, prices, hours or any buying copy; the featured item above is the same under every skin. Ruling 2 of 25 Oct 2026.
dates_verified_by: Sources opened on 2026-10-24; each entry lists its own.

featured.rule: One featured item under every skin (ruling 2 of 25 Oct 2026: a skin never changes the product set, prices, hours or buying copy). Change it on its own schedule, not with a skin.
